verdict.rationale: Cake documents its own bulk upload tools for importing many cap-table records at once from a spreadsheet, so it is a first-party bulk capability. That evidence is limited to import and migration. The MCP integration is explicitly read-only, so AI-driven bulk changes aren't supported, and search/filter/sort is only an adjacent feature. Missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete actions on existing items, bulk grant issuance or approvals, programmatic or AI-driven bulk writes, any public API, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Cake's bulk upload tools can import your data directly. Most spreadsheet-managed cap tables can be migrated in under two hours.
